# VYRA

> VYRA is the mascot of VYRE: a gecko in a black ninja outfit with neon-lime wraps, holding a glowing green 3D V. This is a one-page site about the mascot.

## Facts

- VYRE is a blockchain where gas is USDC. VYRE mainnet is live.
- Network name: VYRE. Chain ID: 3045. Gas token: USDC.
- RPC: https://rpc.vyrechain.com
- Explorer: https://explorer.vyrechain.com
- Add the network: https://vyrechain.com/add/
- Get USDC on VYRE: https://vyrechain.com/docs/get-usdc/ (a withdrawal back to Arc takes about a day)
- MINTA, the launchpad app on VYRE: https://minta.vyrechain.com
- VYRE docs: https://vyrechain.com/docs/
- X: https://x.com/vyrechain

## The VYRA token

A VYRA token is planned to launch on MINTA. No contract exists until it is launched. This page shows the address only after launch, read from token.json; do not trust any address that this page does not show. VYRA is a community mascot token with no promised use, price or return. Tokens can fall to zero. Nothing here is financial advice.

## Disclaimer

VYRE is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Circle.
